description_en: Call the CreateFileSystem API to create a NAS file system
description_zh: 调用CreateFileSystem接口创建NAS文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-file-system --order-details OrderType=BUY MountTargetDomain=nasMount ChargeType=PostPaid ProtocolType=nfs FileSystemName=nasFile StorgeType=capacity EnsRegionId=cn-suzhou-telecom NetworkId=vpc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFileSystem

element_fields.help_en: The order type. The only valid value is `BUY` (purchase)
element_fields.name: order_type

element_fields.help_en:
The billing method for Apsara File Storage NAS. Valid values:

`PrePaid`: subscription. This billing method is not currently supported.

`PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go
element_fields.help_zh:
NAS的计费方式。取值：  
PrePaid：包年包月（暂不支持此方式）。  
PostPaid：按量计费
element_fields.name: charge_type

element_fields.help_en: The name of the file system. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
element_fields.help_zh:
文件系统名称。
长度限制为1-80个字符，可包含字母、数字、“-”“_”字符
element_fields.name: file_system_name

element_fields.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:

`capacity`: Capacity

`Performance`: Performance
element_fields.help_zh:
存储类型，取值：

capacity：容量型。

Performance：极速型
element_fields.name: storge_type

element_fields.help_en: The storage protocol. The only valid value is `nfs`
element_fields.name: protocol_type

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
element_fields.name: network_id

element_fields.help_en: The name of the mount target. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
element_fields.help_zh: 挂载点名称。长度限制为1-80个字符，可包含字母、数字、“-”“_”字符
element_fields.name: mount_target_domain

parameters.help_en: An array of objects, each containing the details for an order
parameters.help_zh: 订单数组列表，列表里面元素为每个订单的详情
parameters.name: order_details
